note: Banks in the United States Virgin Islands are numbered within the United States' routing number system: the American Bankers Association's Routing Number Policy and Procedures (the Routing Number Administrative Board's policy, revised 9/20, read 2026-10-30 on aba.com) defines a Federal Reserve District as one of the twelve areas assigned to a Federal Reserve Bank main office and says all of the United States and its territories fall into one of these twelve districts, whose routing symbols (01-12) begin a bank's routing number. So an account there is numbered as one in the United States, a routing number and an account number. No bank in the islands was read stating its own routing number.

sources.title: American Bankers Association, Routing Number Policy and Procedures (revised 9/20)
sources.said: Federal Reserve District One of the twelve geographic areas assigned to a Federal Reserve Bank main office. All of the United States and its territories fall into one of these twelve districts.
